name: Buer Within: Self Reflection
subtitle: Conversations & Life Manual
description:
Meet yourself with a little more curiosity.

Buer Within brings together guided AI conversations, a personal Life Manual and a daily reflection. Start with a question about work, relationships, decisions or your own rhythms, and take time to notice what matters to you.

START WITH A QUESTION
Explore your thoughts in English or Chinese. Choose a suggested question or write your own. You can optionally use the core summary from your Life Manual as context.

YOUR PERSONAL LIFE MANUAL
Use your birth details to generate a Human Design-based reading on your device. Revisit saved readings in your local history and choose what to bring into a conversation.

A DAILY MOMENT TO REFLECT
Read a daily prompt, share a thoughtfully designed image, or add the daily reflection widget to your Home Screen.

YOU CHOOSE WHAT TO SHARE
Birth details are calculated on your device. AI conversations require your consent before messages are sent to our server and DeepSeek. Your name, birth date, birth time and place are not automatically included in AI requests.

FREE AND OPTIONAL PLUS MEMBERSHIP
Enjoy 3 completed AI replies each day for free, resetting at 00:00 UTC. Failed requests do not use your allowance. Optional monthly or annual Plus membership removes the daily message limit; reasonable rate limits still apply. Local readings remain available without a subscription.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings.

Buer Within is for personal reflection and entertainment. Human Design readings are interpretive and are not scientific assessments. AI may make mistakes. The app does not provide medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.

promotionalText: A question, a personal reading, a daily moment to reflect. Explore yourself in English or Chinese with 3 free AI replies each day.
